source.name: sp_BuildMonthlyReport

result.generatedDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dbo.sp_BuildMonthlyReport(
    p_year INT,
    p_month INT
)
RETURNS TABLE (
    customername TEXT,
    ordercount BIGINT,
    totalrevenue NUMERIC(12,2)
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
    -- Temp table usage
    CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS temp_monthlystats (
        customerid INT,
        ordercount BIGINT,
        totalrevenue NUMERIC(12,2)
    ) ON COMMIT DROP;

    -- Clear temp table in case it exists from previous call
    TRUNCATE TABLE temp_monthlystats;

    INSERT INTO temp_monthlystats
    SELECT
        o.customerid,
        COUNT(*),
        SUM(o.totalamount)
    FROM dbo.orders o
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.orderdate) = p_year 
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.orderdate) = p_month
    GROUP BY o.customerid;

    -- Return results joined with customer info
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        c.firstname || ' ' || c.lastname AS customername,
        ms.ordercount,
        ms.totalrevenue
    FROM temp_monthlystats ms
    INNER JOIN dbo.customers c ON ms.customerid = c.customerid
    ORDER BY ms.totalrevenue DESC;

    -- Temp table will be dropped automatically on commit
END;
$$;

Parameter names prefixed with 'p_' to follow PostgreSQL conventions
DECIMAL(12,2) mapped to NUMERIC(12,2) in PostgreSQL
INT type remains INT in PostgreSQL
COUNT(*) returns BIGINT in PostgreSQL instead of INT
String concatenation converted from '+' to '||' operator
YEAR() and MONTH() functions converted to EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ...) and EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ...)
Temporary table created with ON COMMIT DROP to auto-cleanup
Schema 'dbo' is assumed to exist in PostgreSQL or should be adjusted to target schema
Column names converted to lowercase following PostgreSQL conventions
SET NOCOUNT ON has no direct equivalent and is omitted (PostgreSQL doesn't send row counts by default in functions)
